name: basic select
input: select a,b from c where d=1;
output:
SELECT
  a,
  b
FROM c
WHERE d = 1;

name: DU-26 screenshot query
input: select u.id, u.name, count(o.id) as orders from users u left join orders o on o.user_id = u.id where u.active = 1 and o.created_at > '2024-01-01' group by u.id, u.name having count(o.id) > 3 order by orders desc limit 10;
output:
SELECT
  u.id,
  u.name,
  count(o.id) AS orders
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o
ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.active = 1
  AND o.created_at > '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
HAVING count(o.id) > 3
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 10;

name: DU-26 screenshot query space-4
input: select u.id, u.name, count(o.id) as orders from users u left join orders o on o.user_id = u.id where u.active = 1 and o.created_at > '2024-01-01' group by u.id, u.name having count(o.id) > 3 order by orders desc limit 10;
output:
SELECT
    u.id,
    u.name,
    count(o.id) AS orders
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o
ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.active = 1
    AND o.created_at > '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
HAVING count(o.id) > 3
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 10;

name: joins with ON conditions
input: select * from a inner join b on a.id = b.id left outer join c on a.id=c.id right join d on a.id=d.id full outer join e on a.id=e.id;
output:
SELECT
  *
FROM a
INNER JOIN b
ON a.id = b.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN c
ON a.id = c.id
RIGHT JOIN d
ON a.id = d.id
FULL OUTER JOIN e
ON a.id = e.id;

name: nested sub-selects
input: select a from (select b from c where id in (select id from d));
output:
SELECT
  a
FROM (
  SELECT
    b
  FROM c
  WHERE id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM d
  )
);

name: CASE

    WHEN a = 1 THEN 2
    WHEN a = 3 THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END AS val;
